cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Investment in the Next Round
cards.instruction: Describe defeat, penalty, or a bad bargain as a deliberate investment in a larger future win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The entry fee wasn't wasted. We're buying a better chance at next year's dog show.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You put a blue ribbon on our dog because the judge did. She was marking a winner; you got us disqualified.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, testing how the judging works before we compete seriously.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They run free training sessions. We could learn the routine without entering.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Book us in. I'll watch the winners, and next year we won't spend the entry fee discovering where a ribbon goes.

reason: Differentiate this from the adjacent race failure and establish a concrete copied judging act, its disqualification cost, and an offered free route toward a future win.
